source.name: Sánchez-Pérez et al. 2018 — Biogenic amines in plant foods (Foods, CC BY)

note: Histamine results (mg/kg fresh weight) from Tables 1–3 of Sánchez-Pérez et al., Foods 2018;7(12):205 (open access, CC BY 4.0). The authors' own Spanish market data cite this paper; values they quote from earlier lab studies cite the original study. Values quoted from textbooks or reviews are stored excluded, for comparison only. 'Not detected' is stored as 0. Foods matched by hand to the Pico catalog.
